properties.name: flagship.api-key
properties.description: Project environment SDK API key (e.g. flagship_dev_key_12345).

properties.name: flagship.cache-file-path
properties.description: Local disk cache file path for atomic snapshot persistence and offline recovery.

properties.name: flagship.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for FlagShip SDK integration.

properties.name: flagship.event-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of events to batch before triggering an immediate flush.

properties.name: flagship.event-flush-interval-ms
properties.description: Asynchronous exposure & goal event batch flush interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: flagship.offline-mode
properties.description: If true, runs entirely offline using local disk cache without contacting server.

properties.name: flagship.polling-interval-ms
properties.description: Polling fallback interval in milliseconds when SSE is unavailable or disconnected. Minimum 5000ms.

properties.name: flagship.server-url
properties.description: FlagShip Control Plane Server URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080).

properties.name: flagship.sse-enabled
properties.description: Enable real-time push synchronization via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

properties.name: flagship.startup-timeout-ms
properties.description: Startup bootstrap blocking timeout in milliseconds. Strictly capped at <= 2000 ms.

properties.name: management.endpoint.flagship.access
properties.description: Permitted level of access for the flagship endpoint.

properties.name: management.endpoint.flagship.cache.time-to-live
properties.description: Maximum time that a response can be cached.

properties.name: management.endpoint.flagship.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the flagship endpoint.
